Usage: astryx doctor [options] [command]

Diagnose Astryx projects and integration packages

Options:
  --built <path>  Also check a finished build before you deliver it: a project folder, a build output folder, or one built HTML file. Fails when it does not use Astryx at all, and warns with each raw element, icon or custom style in its source.
  -h, --help      display help for command

Commands:
  integration     Check an integration package while authoring it

Exit codes:
  0  no checks failed (warnings are allowed)
  1  one or more checks failed

Examples:
  # Run project diagnostics
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor
  # Machine-readable project report
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor --json
  # Before you deliver a build: check that it uses Astryx
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor --built dist
  # Validate an integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration validate @acme/widgets
  # Check template ids against Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration templates @acme/widgets
  # Check component names against Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration components @acme/widgets
  # Classify doc overlaps with Core
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration docs @acme/widgets

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/doctor
